subject: Azure Marketplace offer assets & security proofs for Wootton Inc. — next steps

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Azure Marketplace offer assets & security proofs for Wootton Inc. — next steps

Hi Eve — great to see progress on the pilot call last week. To keep momentum for the Azure offer submission and co-sell readiness, can you please provide the following by end of day Wednesday?

- Tenant ID for the Wootton publisher account (Partner Center).
- SOC 2 attestation or gap statement (PDF).
- High-res icons and screenshots for the offer (PNG preferred).
- Short 2–3 paragraph product description for the Partner Center listing (we'll shorten as needed).

I've attached a short checklist (offer_asset_checklist.xlsx) that maps which fields Partner Center expects — use that as a quick reference. Once we have the tenant ID and SOC2, we'll schedule the technical validation call with Azure Marketplace engineering and confirm the manifest/offer JSON.

Proposed times for a 30-min tech validation call: Tue 9/1 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue 9/1 14:00–14:30 PT. Which works for you and your security contact?

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Eve — received the SOC2 and screenshots. Re: the technical validation call, 14:00 PT on Tue 9/1 works for our security lead and for Azure engineering.

Prep notes for the validation call (internal + Eve/security):
- We need to validate the offer manifest JSON: plan IDs, route names, and pricing SKU mapping. I'll bring the draft manifest (wootton-azure-manifest.json) to the call.
- Confirm the allowed data retention window and the integration point for logs (Azure Monitor vs. third-party). Eve noted a third-party vendor in the SOC2 — we'll confirm mapping and any additional evidence needed for Marketplace listing.
- Icons: ask Wootton to provide retina-scale PNG (1024x1024) + 700x300 banner. If they only have PNGs in the zip, we should convert and package into offer-icons.zip for upload.
- DocuSign: Procurement will need the standard SOW + co-sell acceptance form post-offer publication.

Action items:
- Marissa: produce draft manifest and share before the call (I will push to the Google doc link).
- Kimberly: confirm marketplace billing contact and verify whether Wootton needs a reseller/ISV partner relationship configured.
- Dylan: confirm time with Eve and share the meeting invite.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: wootton-azure-manifest.json (draft manifest — to be reviewed in tech call)

From: Azure Marketplace Team <mp-support@microsoft.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Eve Wootton <eve@woottoninc.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace offer assets & security proofs for Wootton Inc. — next steps

Hi all — thanks for the heads up and for submitting the artifacts. A couple of items from Marketplace engineering ahead of the validation call: 

1) Please make sure the draft manifest includes the exact plan IDs and pricing tiers. We can't approve an offer without a plan mapping.
2) Upload the SOC2 PDF to the Partner Center evidence portal and add a short description of the control scope. If there are third-party dependencies, include the vendor name and a mitigation statement.
3) Provide tenant admin access for a read-only Partner Center review account (we only need contributor rights to verify the listing).
4) Use this Partner Center submission link to upload final assets prior to the call: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/items/submit/WOOT-2026-AZ-12345

We'll join the Tue 9/1 14:00 PT call. If you want, forward the meeting invite to mp-support@microsoft.com and we'll attach the tech reviewer.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Engineering
mp-support@microsoft.com
